propositions: Only 12 of 50 plan-review criteria have evaluation specs, leaving 38 criteria with no behavioral regression oracle when rubrics are edited.

The plan-review corpus (6,482 sidecar rows with 0.9568 verified_ratio) contains sufficient metadata (criteria lists, cohort sets, decisions) to generate per-criterion fire/no-fire fixtures retroactively from real review material.

No-fire fixtures must be admitted only when a criterion appears in a finding's cohort set (proving routing) yet fires on no finding in that plan; missing cohort keys are skipped as unknown, never emitted as pass cases.
Non-inline criteria (CONTAINER_CRITERIA, ISF) cannot be mined for fixtures and must generate self-healing unreliable-criterion tickets instead of fixtures.
The mining pipeline must refuse to issue model calls if pre-flight cost estimates exceed the $450 epic ceiling.
